Whole-row consumer improvements observed in repeated records cannot be generalized to chronological dynamic inference.

Chronological 128-step descriptor/history traversal versus alternating two fixed records.
One full chronological warmup per timed pass versus five initial replays per fixed record.
Four versus two fresh-process rounds, different policy ordering, measurement times and sample counts.
